headings.text: Manage at scale.From Stardust to AEM.
More than a renderer. An experience system.
Every market, every campaign, one surface.
Meet stardust:deploy.From static HTML to a live AEM experience.
Two commands. No development in between.

body: Stardust generates clean, deployable static HTML. stardust:deploy turns it into a full AEM Edge Delivery experience — authorable, edge-served globally, optimized for performance and AI brand visibility.
From assembling pages out of shared parts → to generating unique pages that share the same rules.
Implementation partners shipped a library — Hero, Card Grid, Accordion, Tabs — and marketers composed pages from the shelf. Sites got fast by getting boring. It worked.

AI tools now generate bespoke, production-quality HTML — scroll-driven motion, cinematic transitions, three-week designs in an hour — from a prompt and a brand surface. Designers know how to drive them.
Every page can be its own page again — provided the brand keeps the rules. The library's job moves up a level: from shape to guardrails.

AEM Edge Delivery serves static HTML at top-decile performance — but the deeper value is what comes with it: an experience platform for managing every market, every language, every campaign, while keeping the brand control non-negotiable. Stardust generates the artifact; AEM is where that artifact lives at scale.

Authors edit in-place with Universal Editor. Drafts, scheduling, translations, A/B variants, market overrides — all in one place. Roll the same Stardust artifact across regions, products, and seasons without rebuilds.

LLMs synthesize brands from what they can read. Edge Delivery's clean, semantic, structured markup — exactly what Stardust outputs — is what Google AI Mode, Claude, and ChatGPT extract correctly. Your brand survives the synth as you mean it.
100/100 Lighthouse scores aren't aspirational on Edge Delivery — they're the default. Static HTML, edge-cached globally, no client-side framework rehydration. SEO and search ranking follow.

stardust:deploy is the open-source converter that turns a Stardust page into an AEM Edge Delivery experience. Each prototype section becomes one independent EDS block: the section's CSS becomes that block's scoped stylesheet, and its text and images become authorable content. Header and footer drop into static repository fragments, and the page ships as a content fragment to AEM.
· Every section becomes an authorable block · The design is reproduced faithfully ·
From a live URL to a working AEM Edge Delivery experience. Stardust generates the redesign; stardust:deploy converts it into authorable EDS blocks and ships them to AEM.
Generate the redesign. /stardust:uplift <URL> — Stardust crawls the live site, captures the brand surface, and generates three differentiated variants in one run. Approve the one that fits.

Convert and ship to AEM. /stardust:deploy — stardust:deploy turns the chosen variant into EDS blocks and content pages and pushes them into your AEM Edge Delivery project. Run /stardust:diff to confirm the build matches the prototype, then publish.
